todos: [P2] RELIABILITY-CI-01: Verify the GitHub CI run and Dependabot alert reevaluation after publishing the 2026-09-30 reliability changes on master. Local verification passed: 287 files / 2293 Vitest tests, 153 Sidecar tests, static checks, build, Windows packaging and five isolated NSIS cases; npm audit reports 0 vulnerabilities. Continue from docs/reliability-audit-2026-09-30.md; do not repeat local full suites unless remote failures or code changes justify it.

[P2] LIVE-MODEL-HARDWARE-01: Qualify a capable model fitting the available hardware on the exact first prompt in a fresh isolated workspace. qwen3.5:2b and qwen3.5:4b remain unqualified; 9b is not installed. Require passing build/tests, browser feedback reaching the model, navigation, responsive checks at 320-1920 px and milestone evidence. Preserve Desktop/test_app as read-only and the failed workspaces/snapshots. Historical measurements and paths: docs/reliability-audit-2026-09-30.md.

[P2] QWEN38-FULLTASK-01: qwen3.8:27b qualification remains open after transport timeouts and an interrupted CPU-heavy run. Do not automatically resume its retained workspace; evaluate smaller capable models first. Evidence: docs/reliability-audit-2026-09-30.md.

[P2] AGENT-THINKING-RUNAWAY-01: Confirm the implemented 18-minute reasoning cut on a real thinking-model run that crosses the budget; retain transport tests and the two-cut termination guard. Thinking-off runs do not verify this behavior.

[P3] I18N-SIDECAR-MIGRATION-LIVE-01: Isolated nonempty migration and backup rollback passed; actual app userData had no legacy chunks. Confirm on the first real nonempty legacy corpus. Evidence: docs/reliability-audit-2026-09-30.md.

[P3] LIVE-RUN-RESIDUE-CLEANUP-01: Preserve failed-run workspaces, profiles and snapshots until diagnosis is complete. Remove only known test residues when policy permits, protecting app userData, Ollama models and the OnlyRag-Live root. Exact retained paths and prior approval failures: docs/reliability-audit-2026-09-30.md.

[P3] LEGACY-SESSION-COMPAT-01: Keep identity-free plan seeds and fallback-session migration until a released version has migrated real nonempty legacy data with verified backup/readback. Then inventory registered workspaces and both fallback stores again; preserve the 21 dev state files pending provenance review. Evidence: docs/reliability-audit-2026-09-30.md.

[P3] NSIS-UNINSTALL-UI-01: Complete visual checkbox and installed-app upgrade/uninstall verification in an isolated VM. Production packaging and five redirected NSIS policy fixtures passed on 2026-09-30; checkbox state was simulated. Installer signature was not verifiable because Microsoft.PowerShell.Security did not load. Preserve actual app userData. Evidence: docs/reliability-audit-2026-09-30.md.
